choice_token_bias_mining.adaptive_effort_specific_note: The frozen ADAPTIVE_EFFORT CONTINUE prompt expects C and lies near the A/C decision boundary in several seeds. The four late revisits move all six duplicated copies by the same signed-margin amount within each seed because they are the same prompt.
choice_token_bias_mining.discriminator_note: DISCRIMINATOR_SELECTION ALREADY_IDENTIFIED also expects C and shows subthreshold improvement while complementary A-expected variants worsen, consistent with a broad A-vs-C calibration movement rather than family-specific semantic transfer.
choice_token_bias_mining.current_best_explanation: A substantial portion of the observed categorical Adaptive-Effort late-revisit flip is explainable by a global answer-token calibration shift from A toward C; semantic reasoning gain is not established by this readout.
choice_token_bias_mining.guard: CHOICE-LETTER CALIBRATION MOVEMENT != SEMANTIC CAPABILITY ACQUISITION
